thread:
Priya: Hey @Marta — quick preboarding thread for your new hire (Luca) starting Mon 3/22. I put together a lightweight mgr checklist. TL;DR: IT, access, intro, 7-day goals.
Marta: Thanks! can you drop the list? also do we have a buddy assigned?
Priya: Yep. Buddy is Diego — he'll do team walkthroughs. Checklist: 1) Submit device request to Eng-Infra 2) Slack + Google access 3) Calendar invites (team + 1:1 + onboarding sync) 4) Workspace setup guide link: https://redwood.io/onboard-guide 5) Schedule intro + role expectations meeting.
Marta: Device request — do I fill a form or just ping eng-infra?
Ava: You can fill the "new-devices" form but pinging eng-infra accelerates. I usually include asset tag preference. :rocket:
Diego: I'll block 30m on Mon for team intro and 1h Tue for walkthroughs. Also will shadow the first onboarding sync.
Priya: For manager-specific items: A) 30/60/90 draft to send by EOD Tue B) plan first-week checkpoints (Day1, Day3, End of Week) C) set success metrics (OKRs / top 3 deliverables)
Marta: For the 30/60/90, any template? want something quick to send to Luca.
Sam: Use the "manager-30-60-90" template in Drive: drive.redwood/hr/templates/manager-30-60-90.md. Keep it high level: learn, contribute, own.
Marta: Cool. Quick Q: who to contact for badge/door access?
Ava: Facilities — @facilities (sla ~2 business days). If urgent, loop in me and I can ask for same-day.
Marta: One blocker — Luca needs AWS account access; I don't have perms to request. Who approves?
Priya: For AWS Prod-level, submit ticket to security-approvals and tag me + eng-sre. For dev-level, Diego can request via infra-perms.
Diego: I'll file the dev-level access now. If security needs more, I'll route to Priya.
onboard-bot: Reminder: new hire welcome packet emailed to Luca at 8:00am PST on start date.
Marta: Thanks all. I'll draft the 30/60/90 and share here tomorrow. Anything else for Day0 preboarding?
Priya: If possible, add 3 short reading items about stack + the team's current priorities. Keeps Day1 focused on hands-on.
Marta: Will do. :thumbsup:
Diego: Also ping me if they want a pre-read repo access — I can open a PR to add them to the github team.
Priya: Awesome. Closing checklist: device req, calendar invites, buddy intro, 30/60/90 draft, AWS dev access, facilities badge. I'll update our tracker.
Marta: Perfect — thanks everyone!
